summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (placed after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), with the four helper methods and forward per spec, plus the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias. Exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py. Added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class cases. Nothing was run: per the instructions, the code and tests were checked by reading only. I did not commit. The batch-coupling example was verified by hand (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss about 0.333). Open choices: a numpy float64 matrix makes the loss float64, since I kept m in the numpy-converted type as the spec says.
